Question 2

The population p, in millions, of a particular colony of bacteria after t days can be modeled by the function p(t)=2t2+1ln⁡2. What is the instantaneous rate of change of the bacteria population as a function of t?

a
 2⋅2t3 million bacteria per day
b
 2t2+1 million bacteria per day
c
 2⋅2t2+1 million bacteria per day
d
 2t⋅2t2+1 million bacteria per day
e
 1t⋅2t2+1 million bacteria per day
